verdict.rationale: Codegen explicitly documents triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines (e.g., on build failures) and offers a Python SDK plus CLI for programmatic/scripted invocation, which supports headless usage in pipelines and scripts. However, there's no dedicated CI/CD integration guide, no example pipeline configs (e.g., GitHub Actions YAML), and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-world headless CI usage. missing for 10: concrete CI/CD pipeline examples or config snippets, exit-code/status handling for scripts, independent verification of headless operation in automated pipelines.
